estimand: Design-weighted objective residual translation-defect prevalence in the 1,396-revision frozen eligible frame.

weight_contract.exact_serialization: Store every realized design weight and aggregate as a reduced rational. A JSON floating value may be canonicalized to an integer or one-decimal rational only when equal within 1e-9 and its reciprocal inclusion probability agrees within 1e-9.
required_checks: 40 unique sampled tasks and 40 unique canonical revisions
every pi_i is strictly positive and at most one
realized exact weights sum to each frozen stratum size and to 1396
weight_contract.ht_hajek_equivalence_for_this_design: This equivalence is specific to the frozen design, not a general property. In same_family_only, 19 certainty tasks contribute exact weight 717; the remaining 11 tasks contain 16 revisions, exactly 5 tasks are selected, and every selected noncertainty revision has pi=5/16 and weight=16/5, contributing 16. The stratum weight sum is therefore always 733. The two census-task strata have exact sums 569 and 94. Thus sum(w)=N within every stratum and overall for every valid realization of this design.

primary_bounds.upper: U = sum_i(w_i * I(verdict_i in {CONFIRMED, INDETERMINATE, UNREACHABLE})) / sum_i(w_i)
primary_bounds.interpretation: Always report L and U. They are design-weighted missing-evidence identification bounds for the realized sample, not confidence limits.

point_estimate.availability_gate: Report only when at least 90% of the 40 sampled units have verdict CONFIRMED or REFUTED.
point_estimate.primary: Horvitz-Thompson known-denominator rate: sum_i(w_i * y_i) / 1396, with y_i defined only for determinate verdicts. Because the gate does not make missingness ignorable, this value is reported as a population point estimate only when no item is INDETERMINATE or UNREACHABLE; otherwise report a determinate-only conditional sensitivity analysis instead.
point_estimate.secondary: Hájek ratio sensitivity estimate: sum_i(w_i * y_i) / sum_i(w_i) over determinate items, explicitly labeled conditional if any reference outcome is missing.
point_estimate.unweighted_descriptive: sum_i(y_i) / count_i(y_i observed), labeled sample-only and never substituted for the design-weighted estimate.

prevalence_estimators.strata: Repeat exact lower, upper and—when fully determinate—point calculations within each frozen stratum. Treat between-stratum differences as descriptive, never causal.

uncertainty.reason: The single systematic-PPS realization has no generally unbiased variance estimator from first-order inclusion probabilities alone, and only one revision was observed per sampled task, so within-task variance is not estimable. Binomial, iid bootstrap and model-based confidence intervals are prohibited for confirmatory reporting.
uncertainty.future_precision_claim: Requires a new design with variance-identifiable replication or frozen joint inclusion probabilities and an adequate per-task second stage.

origin_pilot_budget_priority.formula: confirmed item count >= 4 AND distinct confirmed task count >= 4 AND determinate gate passes AND provenance-classifiable gate passes
origin_pilot_budget_priority.effect: Passing gives the separately designed origin pilot budget priority. Failing defers that pilot; it is not evidence that reviewer-origin interaction is absent.

reviewer_scoring.prediction_positive: A valid route output label DEFECT for the audit_id.
reviewer_scoring.prediction_negative: A valid route output label NO_DEFECT for the audit_id.
reviewer_scoring.invalid_route_policy: Missing, duplicate, reordered, unparsable or out-of-schema item output invalidates the whole route result as a model score; harness or transport failures are repaired or retried under the later frozen runner policy and are not model scores.
reviewer_scoring.binary_nomination_role: The weighted confusion metrics below describe whether a route nominated an item. They are secondary. A DEFECT label with the wrong reason does not establish detection of the sealed defect atom.
reviewer_scoring.primary_atom_detection_requirement: Before reviewer inference, freeze a minimal reviewer-hidden atom map and deterministic matching rubric. On a positive item, a wrong-rationale DEFECT nomination is an off-target candidate plus a missed reference atom, not a detected atom. Do not derive the atom matcher after seeing route output.
reviewer_scoring.weighted_confusion_cells: For scorable references, nomination HT_TP=sum(w*y*p), HT_FN=sum(w*y*(1-p)), HT_FP=sum(w*(1-y)*p), HT_TN=sum(w*(1-y)*(1-p)).
reviewer_scoring.zero_denominator: Serialize the affected ratio as null; never coerce it to zero or one.
required_parallel_report: unweighted TP, FN, FP and TN item counts
R033 detection as an explicit boolean because the reference has only one positive item
candidate item count and design-weighted candidate mass
invalid or failed route status separately from all metrics
reviewer_scoring.interpretation_limit: With one confirmed positive, route recall is a one-item feasibility observation and must not be presented as stable model capability.

reporting_rules: Keep natural residual prevalence separate from reviewer detection metrics.
Report exact fractions and decimal expansions together.
Do not call missingness bounds confidence intervals.
Do not report a precision claim or rank reviewer routes from this one-positive pilot.
Keep the sealed reference minimal: audit ID, canonical revision UID, stratum, scoring label, exact weight and source-audit item hash only.
Do not reveal this contract, the sealed reference, verdicts, findings, provenance strata or design weights to reviewer routes.
